newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: WBL to net US$32.7 million from ALR sale.
newsitem.headline: WBL to net US$32.7 million from ALR sale.

text.p: WBL Corporation Ltd said on Friday the proposed sale of its stake in Advanced Logic Research Inc (ALR) would result in an extraordinary gain of US$32.7 million.
The company had agreed to sell its 38.9 percent stake in ALR to Gateway 2000 Inc for US$15.50 a share, it said.
The sale would result in an increase in the consolidated net tangible assets per share of WBL as at March 31 997 by Singapore $0.41 per share to S$3.49.
WBL said it proposed to use the net cash surplus from the sale of about US$74.1 million to expand its growing proprietary technology products and services and to reduce bank borrowings.
The company's shares had been suspended on Friday prior to the announcement.
